description: Phase F4 Golden Set — 50 commanders spanning the major Commander archetypes. The first 25 entries are the original Phase 4.2 set (sacrifice, tribal, counters, spellslinger, ETB, combat, lifegain, mill, ninjutsu). The next 25 cover the gaps identified in the F3 post-mortem: voltron/equipment, enchantress/artifact, lands-matter, reanimator, non-tribal tokens, storm/combo, stax/control, monarch/politics, mono-color ramp, and 4-5 color good-stuff. Every commander has a verified oracle_id in the Forge snapshot AND an EDHREC synergy row in data/tags.db — both rails are measurable.
commanders: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose
